newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record high in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record high in quiet trade.

text.p: Swedish shares ended at a record high in quiet trade on Monday.
The exchange's general index climbed 0.8 percent to a record close of 2,795.31 in turnover of 4.47 billion crowns.
"This was a very quiet journey," a trader said. "The most interesting news was when the Dutch central bank raised rates. But after a certain volatility, also that was soon forgotten."
"Everybody thinks the bourse will continue to rise but most of the major companies are already trading at high levels. Instead players look for small companies' shares which is a bit worrying."
Astra clawed back some of its earlier losses, fuelled by stronger pharmaceutical shares in the U.S. The share jumped six crowns to 376. Pharmacia & Upjohn ended 6.5 crowns higher at 300.5.
Forestry dropped, hit by the sector's performance in New York. MoDo fell seven to 243.5.
Medical and industrial gas group AGA AB rose five to 111 crowns after Swiss BZ Group Holdin AG's bought a stake in Swiss investment group Gas Vision AG, AGA's largest shareholder.
